content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Des Moines

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree and completion of formal project management education—no prior work experience needed. This makes CAPM ideal for Des Moines professionals entering the field, especially those in insurance, financial services, healthcare, and government roles seeking structured credentials quickly.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp format. Our intensive course covers the PMBOK® Guide framework and prepares you for exam day. Attend sessions on your schedule from anywhere, with active certified practitioners leading real-world discussions throughout.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with PMI and apply for the CAPM credential before scheduling your exam. Complete the application truthfully, documenting your 23 contact hours of education. Pay the required exam fee to activate your testing eligibility with PMI's testing partner.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-prep resources, including practice exams and study guides, to reinforce core competencies. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI's testing platform. Our instructors remain available to answer final questions before you sit for the assessment.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM certification is valid for three years. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through continuing education, work experience, or volunteer service to renew your credential. Stay current with PMI's maintenance requirements to keep your competitive edge in Des Moines's project-driven organizations.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.
